name: FCC 255 (Hubble)
blurb: FCC 255, an early-type galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fcc255-hubble
story: An early-type galaxy in the Fornax Cluster with a compact nucleus at its center. Hubble imaged it as one of 43 early-type galaxies in the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey.

claims.text: FCC 255 is an early-type galaxy in the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey sample, also listed as E358-G50
The ACS Fornax Cluster Survey imaged 43 early-type galaxies in Fornax with Hubble's ACS (GO program 10217)
